theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_pc_imrep_orient_fixed_by_retraction
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (U N O : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 d N → MeasurableSet O → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ N) = 0 → (∀ x ∈ N ∩ O, f x = x) → (∀ x ∈ N ∩ O, ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace N x, fderiv ℝ f x v = v) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ O)), f x = x ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, R.orient x (α.compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) = R.orient x α
